title: Input matched multisignal colocalization clarifies regulatory assignments at primary biliary cholangitis loci
description: PBC regulatory attribution reliability research compendium. R7C3G rebuilds the manuscript narrative and 34 traceable panels with unchanged scientific endpoints and Source Data; R7C3G1 reorganizes the public repository into eight canonical directories. The prespecified 642 high-information comparisons, same-input bidirectional reclassification, model sensitivity, known-truth simulation trade-offs and bounded external/tissue evidence are reported. This is an editorial review candidate: exact-version author review, publisher proof and journal submission remain pending. Participant-level external independence, chromatin mediation and universal algorithm superiority are not established. This metadata file does not establish a Zenodo deposit or DOI.
